parameters.name: Architecture
parameters.description:
The architecture types of the instance type. Valid values:

- X86: x86 computing.
- Heterogeneous: heterogeneous computing, such as GPU or FPGA.
- BareMental: ECS Bare Metal Instance.
- Arm: Arm computing.

Default value: all architecture types.

parameters.name: BurstablePerformance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include burstable performance instance types. Valid values:

- Exclude: excludes burstable performance instance types.
- Include: includes burstable performance instance types.
- Required: includes only burstable performance instance types.

Default value: Include.

parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description:
The channel ID.
>This parameter is not publicly available (internal reserved parameter only).

parameters.name: Cores
parameters.description: The number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

parameters.name: CoresList
parameters.description: The number of vCPU cores of the instance type. You can specify multiple values.

parameters.name: CpuArchitectures
parameters.description: The CPU architectures of the instance type.

parameters.name: ExcludedInstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance types to exclude. You can use wildcard characters (*) to exclude a single instance type or an entire instance family. Examples:

- ecs.c6.large: excludes the ecs.c6.large instance type.
- ecs.c6.*: excludes all instance types in the c6 instance family.

>To exclude multiple instance types, separate them with forward slashes (/). Example: `ecs.n1.small/ecs.n1.*/*7*`.

parameters.name: GpuSpecs
parameters.description: The GPU types.

parameters.name: InstanceCategories
parameters.description:
The instance type categories. Valid values:

- General-purpose: general-purpose type.
- Compute-optimized: compute-optimized type.
- Memory-optimized: memory-optimized type.
- Big data: big data type.
- Local SSDs: local SSD type.
- High Clock Speed: high clock speed type.
- Enhanced: enhanced type.
- Shared: shared type.
- Compute-optimized with GPU: GPU compute-optimized type.
- Visual Compute-optimized: visual compute-optimized type.
- Heterogeneous Service: heterogeneous service type.
- Compute-optimized with FPGA: FPGA compute-optimized type.
- Compute-optimized with NPU: NPU compute-optimized type.
- ECS Bare Metal: ECS Bare Metal Instance.
- High Performance Compute: high performance computing type.

parameters.name: InstanceFamilyLevel
parameters.description:
The level of the instance family. Valid values:

- EntryLevel: entry-level, shared instance type. Lower cost but no guaranteed stable computing performance. Suitable for scenarios with generally low CPU utilization. For more information, see [Shared instance families](~~108489~~).
- EnterpriseLevel: enterprise-level. Stable performance with dedicated resources. Suitable for scenarios that require high stability. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~).
- CreditEntryLevel: credit-based entry-level, burstable performance instance. Uses CPU credits to ensure computing performance. Suitable for scenarios with normally low CPU utilization and occasional spikes. For more information, see [Burstable performance instances](~~59977~~).

parameters.name: InstanceTypeFamilies
parameters.description: The instance type families to query. N indicates that you can specify multiple instance type families. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: MaxPrice
parameters.description: The maximum acceptable hourly price for pay-as-you-go or preemptible instances.

parameters.name: MaximumCpuCoreCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

parameters.name: MaximumGpuAmount
parameters.description: The maximum number of GPUs of the instance. Valid values: positive integers.

parameters.name: MaximumMemorySize
parameters.description: The maximum memory size of the instance. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: The memory size of the instance type. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: MemoryList
parameters.description: The memory size of the instance type. Unit: GiB. You can specify multiple values.

parameters.name: MinimumBaselineCredit
parameters.description: The minimum baseline vCPU computing performance (sum of all vCPUs) for burstable performance instances t5 and t6.

parameters.name: MinimumCpuCoreCount
parameters.description: The minimum number of vCPU cores of the instance type.

parameters.name: MinimumEniIpv6AddressQuantity
parameters.description: The minimum number of IPv6 addresses per ENI for the instance.

parameters.name: MinimumEniPrivateIpAddressQuantity
parameters.description: The minimum number of IPv4 addresses per ENI for the instance.

parameters.name: MinimumEniQuantity
parameters.description: The minimum number of elastic network interfaces (ENIs) supported by the instance.

parameters.name: MinimumGpuAmount
parameters.description: The minimum number of GPUs of the instance. Valid values: positive integers.

parameters.name: MinimumInitialCredit
parameters.description: The minimum initial vCPU credits for burstable performance instances t5 and t6.

parameters.name: MinimumMemorySize
parameters.description: The minimum memory size of the instance. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: PhysicalProcessorModels
parameters.description: The processor models of the instance. N indicates that you can specify multiple processor models. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region.

parameters.name: SpotStrategy
parameters.description:
The bidding policy for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: a preemptible instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
- SpotAsPriceGo: a preemptible instance for which the system automatically bids with the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The list of vSwitch IDs.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The list of zone IDs. This parameter is invalid when vSwitch IDs are specified.
